neighbours.label: tokens in public-key cryptography / PKI text (certificates, keys, signing, certificate authorities)
fire: The browser rejected the site because its TLS certificate had been revoked by the issuing authority.
Each server signs the handshake with its private key, and clients verify it against the public key.
Before deploying, import the root certificate into the trust store and check the certificate chain.
The protocol relies on elliptic-curve signatures so that forged messages fail verification.
An intermediate certificate authority can issue certificates on behalf of the root CA.
Run gpg --import on the vendor's signing key, then verify the package signature.
Mutual TLS requires both client and server to present an X.509 certificate during the handshake.
If the private key leaks, the certificate must be revoked and a new key pair generated.
quiet: The school gave her a certificate of achievement for perfect attendance this year.
He left the house key under the mat so his sister could feed the cat.
She framed her birth certificate and her diploma and hung them in the hallway.
The gift certificate covers dinner for two at the Italian place downtown.
Each guest signed the guestbook at the door before the wedding reception began.
The locksmith cut a spare key for the shed and oiled the old padlock.
Passengers present their boarding pass and passport at the gate before departure.
The landlord changed the locks after the tenant moved out and kept the old keys.
